name: wbfm-node
label: FM broadcast — server half
description:
Server-side half of the WBFM receiver. SoapySource reads IQ off an RTL-SDR at 2.4 MS/s, a Channelizer pulls a 240 kS/s VFO to baseband at the tuner offset (0 Hz here = centre), and WsBridgeTx marshals the narrowband IQ to the browser on stream 2. Browser's half (flowgraphs/wbfm.json) receives the IQ via WsIqSource on the same stream and does decimation → FM demod → audio.

This is a hand-authored node-only preset for M2; in M4 both halves will live in a single cross-env doc that split_for_environment carves at load time.
